english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a proposal or offer that someone has put forward.
Use this when the suggestion is specifically a proposal put forward for consideration, rather than general advice.

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 tai4 ji5 gei2 kap1 jan5

examples.english: I want to put forward a suggestion at the meeting to add another class.
examples.traditional: 我想喺會上提議加開一班。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 wui6 soeng6 tai4 ji5 gaa1 hoi1 jat1 baan1
